column1: # Wall materials sampled from the retail buildings. A 'material' here is a PALETTE: these models
# carry no textures, only a 4x2 image of eight flat colours that the mesh indexes per vertex.
# wall/reveal are texel INDICES measured off the model -- wall = the texel covering the most vertical
# area, reveal = the texel on the strips whose short side is the wall thickness. thick is that
# measured thickness. UVs sampled V-flipped, the same convention ObjMesh.cs uses on these textures.
